newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sees slight increase in September tea crop.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sees slight increase in September tea crop.

text.p: Kenya said it produced 19,828,551 kg of tea in September, up 277,198 kgs or 1.42 percent over the same month last year.
Mombasa-based African Tea Brokers Limited said the total for 1996 so far was 189.85 million kg, an increase of 11.53 million kg or 6.47 percent over the same period the previous year.
The crop showed a seasonal increase despite intermittent rain in most tea growing areas, with hail reported west of the Rift Valley.

It said four sales were held in September when 209,772 packages were sold at an average price of $1.49, compared with five sales in September last year when 258,872 packages were sold at an average $1.26.
Prices for brighter teas of all grades eased by five to eight cents and lower medium and plainer offerings were two to three cents dearer.
